decisions.reason: The literal makes the same 太尉 error for Li Hui.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 加檢校太尉

decisions.reason: 貝州王饒加檢校太尉 is likewise Acting Grand Commandant, not grand general.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 貝州王饒加檢校太尉

decisions.reason: The literal repeats Grand General for 檢校太尉 in Wang Rao's promotion.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 王饒加檢校太尉

decisions.reason: 郭崇為澶州節度使 transfers him to Chanzhou, not Cangzhou.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 郭崇為澶州節度使

decisions.reason: The literal assigns Guo Chong to Cangzhou against 澶州節度使.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 為澶州節度使，加同平章事

decisions.reason: 河陽劉詞加檢校太尉 is Acting Grand Commandant, not grand general.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 河陽劉詞加檢校太尉

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the 太尉/Grand General error for Liu Ci.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 劉詞加檢校太尉

decisions.reason: 尚書左僕射 and 右僕射 are vice directors of the Department of State Affairs, not of personnel.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 範質加尚書左僕射，監修國史李穀加右僕射

decisions.reason: The literal maps 尚書左僕射 to the Ministry of Personnel. Both Fan Zhi and Li Gu receive Shangshu vice-directorships.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 尚書左僕射…加右僕射

decisions.reason: 尚書戶部侍郎 is Vice Minister of Revenue. 'Ministry of Personnel' is an invented 吏部 affiliation.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 尚書戶部侍郎王溥

decisions.reason: The burial instruction names 澶州, not 滄州. Chanzhou is the place for the cap and crimson gauze robe.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 澶州葬通天冠、絳紗袍

decisions.reason: The literal repeats Cangzhou for the same 澶州 burial site.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 澶州葬通天冠、絳紗袍

decisions.reason: 太常卿 is already the sacrifices director in this chapter's compressed annalistic style. Expanding the title to match the literal is a stylistic preference, not a semantic error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太常卿田敏上尊謚

decisions.after: This compiler notes that in the reign of Shizong of Zhou an edict ordered this censor to compile the 《Veritable Records of Zhou Taizu》; matters concerning Dao were therefore properly omitted.)〉
decisions.reason: The original omits 周 and 御史臣. 'The censor-subject' can be read as a third person; 御史臣 here is the commentator himself, as in the literal 'this censor'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 周世宗朝，詔御史臣修《周祖實錄》
